prompt: A repository administrator wants to limit which actions run in that one repository, below the organization’s ceiling. Can they?
explanation: Policy flows downward: an organization sets the ceiling, and a repository may tighten below it with its own allow list. What a repository can never do is exceed the organization’s or enterprise’s allowance — restrictions compose, permissions do not.

options.text: No — repository settings cannot act below organization policy
Yes — repository Actions settings can be more restrictive than the organization’s
Only by disabling Actions in the repository
